name: Entertainment Network (India) Ltd
title: Entertainment Network (India) Ltd - 532700 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Radio volume share held at 25.2% but non-FCT events fell in Q4 and Gaana quarterly growth slowed to roughly 10-15%; digital now 48% of radio revenue with breakeven targeted in FY27.

triggers.label: Q4 volume growth flat
triggers.quote: Volume growth has largely been flat. It's been a tough quarter.

triggers.label: Gaana annual price INR499 to INR799
triggers.quote: we have now gone at to INR799 an annual pack

triggers.label: Q4 non-FCT disrupted by war
triggers.quote: business was impacted as a result of the macroeconomic and geopolitical challenges intensified by the war situation

triggers.label: Gaana breakeven targeted FY27
triggers.quote: FY '27 is a year where we look at breakeven

guidance.value: FY27 breakeven, could be defining year
guidance.quote: FY '27 could be the defining year for that.

red_flags.label: Income tax demand ~INR113 crore for FY24
red_flags.quote: that resulted in a demand of INR113 crores

red_flags.label: Q4 non-FCT decline and cancelled concerts
red_flags.quote: A couple of our international artist concerts had to be canceled

red_flags.label: Management declined CAC/LTV disclosure
red_flags.quote: I don't think in this open call , that's like sharing all your secrets.

evasions.quote: I don't think in this open call , that's like sharing all your secrets.
